graded_case_sampling_policy.selection: The hidden grader uses six fixed deterministic records selected before evaluation from this disclosed envelope. At least four are strong-motion records, at least three have long predominant period, and the suite includes both a short-period DBE record and a high-intensity long-period MCE record. The same disclosed structural model and generator are used without hidden coefficients.
graded_case_sampling_policy.phase_seed_rule: An integer seed selects only the Fourier phases in synthesize_ground_motion; seed does not change the spectrum, envelope, PGA scaling, model, metrics, or scoring. Robust designs should be screened over several seeds, not one realization.
